g.text: 12-16 V DC -> protected PVDD -> stereo BTL amplifier.

g.desc: 12-16 V DC -> protected PVDD -> stereo BTL amplifier.

g.text: PVDD -> 4.30 V FPWM buck -> ESP32 3.3 V LDO + DAC 3.3 V low-noise LDO.

g.desc: PVDD -> 4.30 V FPWM buck -> ESP32 3.3 V LDO + DAC 3.3 V low-noise LDO.

g.text: PCM5122 LEFT = tweeter / J17; RIGHT = woofer / J16. Both speaker returns are active.

g.desc: PCM5122 LEFT = tweeter / J17; RIGHT = woofer / J16. Both speaker returns are active.

g.text: C21: onboard 47u / 50V bipolar Nichicon UES; JP1 shorts it for stereo use.

g.desc: C21: onboard 47u / 50V bipolar Nichicon UES; JP1 shorts it for stereo use.

g.text: No passive crossover. DSP crossover/EQ/limiting remains a firmware and acoustic task.

g.desc: No passive crossover. DSP crossover/EQ/limiting remains a firmware and acoustic task.

g.text: STARTUP: rails settle -> ESP32 boots (SDZ low, MUTE high, XSMT low).

g.desc: STARTUP: rails settle -> ESP32 boots (SDZ low, MUTE high, XSMT low).

g.text: Configure PCM5122 at 0x4C with both channels muted; configure DSP and valid 64fs I2S.

g.desc: Configure PCM5122 at 0x4C with both channels muted; configure DSP and valid 64fs I2S.

g.text: Release DAC XSMT with valid muted I2S; enable SDZ, wait >=50 ms, release MUTE; ramp volume.

g.desc: Release DAC XSMT with valid muted I2S; enable SDZ, wait >=50 ms, release MUTE; ramp volume.

g.text: SHUTDOWN: ramp down, assert DAC XSMT low >=150/fs +0.2 ms; assert MUTE then SDZ low.

g.desc: SHUTDOWN: ramp down, assert DAC XSMT low >=150/fs +0.2 ms; assert MUTE then SDZ low.

g.text: FAULT: mute and shut down, log fault; deliberate retry only after fault cause is removed.

g.desc: FAULT: mute and shut down, log fault; deliberate retry only after fault cause is removed.

g.text: Review report and bench validation are required before connecting the real drivers.

g.desc: Review report and bench validation are required before connecting the real drivers.
